name: Retro 98
description: A retro 90s desktop look for Orca: silver panels, navy highlights, a black retro terminal and pixel-art file icons. Includes an app theme, a terminal theme and an icon theme.

cover.alt: Retro 98 theme in Orca: light gray panels, yellow folder icons and a black retro terminal

screenshots.caption: App theme, icons and retro terminal together

screenshots.alt: File explorer showing Retro 98 pixel folder and file icons
screenshots.caption: Pixel-art folder and file icons in the explorer
